hooks.command: f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$f" in */.github/workflows/*.yml|*/.github/workflows/*.yaml) ruby -ryaml -e 'begin; YAML.load_file(ARGV[0]); rescue Psych::SyntaxError => e; warn "Invalid YAML in #{ARGV[0]}: #{e.message}"; exit 2; end' "$f" || exit 2; if command -v actionlint >/dev/null 2>&1; then actionlint "$f" >&2 || exit 2; fi;; esac
